transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having trouble going to the toilet, dear. I'm opening my bowels much less often and I have to strain a lot.
Could you tell me when this started, and whether it came on suddenly or gradually?
It started about three weeks ago, I think. It came on gradually, not all at once.
Do you have any allergies, or have you ever had a bad reaction to any medicine?
No, I don't have any allergies to medicines that I know of.
Could you tell me how this is affecting your daily life, and what medicines or tablets you take regularly or have taken recently, including any new or changed ones?

It's made me uncomfortable, dear — my lower tummy feels bloated and the straining hurts a bit. I take co-codamol 30/500, two tablets four times a day, which I started about a month ago for back pain. I also take apixaban, bisoprolol, and a calcium and vitamin D chewable tablet.
Aside from your back pain, is there anything else about your past health — such as other health problems, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays — that you’d like to add?
I have osteoarthritis in my spine and knees, and I have an irregular heartbeat.
Have you noticed anything at all that seems to make going to the toilet easier or harder for you?
I've been drinking less than I used to — only about three cups of tea a day — to avoid getting up at night. I think that's made it harder.
Is there anything else you've noticed going on around the same time as the trouble with your bowels?
No, nothing like that — there's no blood in my stools, no black stools, and I haven't been sick.
Aside from the medicines you've already mentioned, is there anything else you take — any other regular medicines, or anything you've started or changed recently?
No, that's all of them — nothing else that I take regularly or that's changed recently.
What’s worrying you most about all this, and what are you hoping we can help you with today?
I'd like something to get things moving again. But I'm also worried it could be something serious, like bowel cancer.

Aside from what you've already mentioned, is there anything else in your past health — any other ongoing health problems, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays — that you think I should know about?
No, I don't think there's anything else. Just the arthritis and the irregular heartbeat I mentioned.

Can you tell me more about how your trouble going to the toilet has been over time — is it there all the time or does it come and go, how often does it happen, how long does it last, and is there a particular time of day when you notice it?
Oh, I go most days, really. It doesn't seem to come and go — it's just been harder and slower than usual for the last few weeks.
Has any of this been having an effect on your day-to-day life — things like sleep, appetite, getting around, or your usual activities?
Just the bloating and the discomfort, dear — my lower tummy feels full and the straining is uncomfortable. I haven't noticed it affecting anything else much.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
